ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there are three rectangles placed side by side and with the same height, and the areas 12, 18, 22 are respectively marked inside the rectangles. The bottom line segment AB extends from the leftmost end across the first two rectangles to the boundary between the second and third rectangles, and is marked as 6 cm. The top line segment CD extends from the boundary between the first and second rectangles across the last two rectangles to the rightmost end, and its length is required. Reasoning: Let the common height of the three rectangles be h. Because area = width × height, the widths of the three rectangles are respectively 12/h, 18/h, 22/h. From the figure it can be known that AB is the sum of the widths of the first two rectangles, therefore 12/h + 18/h = 30/h = 6, solving gives h = 5. CD is the sum of the widths of the last two rectangles, so CD = 18/h + 22/h = 40/5 = 8 cm.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as three side-by-side rectangles of equal height with areas 12, 18, and 22. From the image, AB spans the bottoms of the first two rectangles, while CD spans the tops of the second and third rectangles. Let the common height be h. Then the widths of the three rectangles are 12/h, 18/h, and 22/h. Since AB = 12/h + 18/h = 30/h = 6, solve h = 5. Then CD = 18/h + 22/h = 40/5 = 8 cm.

推理：设三个矩形的共同高度为 h。因为面积 = 宽 × 高，所以三个矩形的宽分别为 12/h、18/h、22/h。由图可知 AB 是前两个矩形宽度之和，因此 12/h + 18/h = 30/h = 6，解得 h = 5。CD 是后两个矩形宽度之和，所以 CD = 18/h + 22/h = 40/5 = 8 cm。

method.method_draft: Read from the diagram that AB is the total width of the rectangles with areas 12 and 18, and CD is the total width of the rectangles with areas 18 and 22. Because all three rectangles have the same height, any horizontal length made from adjacent rectangles is proportional to the sum of their areas. Therefore CD/AB = (18 + 22)/(12 + 18) = 40/30 = 4/3. With AB = 6 cm, CD = 6 × 4/3 = 8 cm.
